# compile_tex

Nguồn: [manim.utils.tex_file_writing.compile_tex](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.utils.tex_file_writing.html#manim.utils.tex_file_writing.compile_tex)

compile\_tex(*tex\_file*, *tex\_compiler*, *output\_format*)
:   Compiles a tex\_file into a .dvi or a .xdv or a .pdf

    Parameters:
    :   - **tex\_file** (*Path*) – File name of TeX file to be typeset.
        - **tex\_compiler** (*str* *|* *list**[**str**]*) – The TeX compiler(s) to be used.
          Can be a single compiler (e.g. `"latex"`, `"pdflatex"` `"lualatex"`) or a list of compilers to compile in order (e.g. `["lualatex", "pdflatex"]`).
        - **output\_format** (*str*) – String containing the output format generated by the compiler, e.g. `.dvi` or `.pdf`

    Returns:
    :   Path to generated output file in desired format (DVI, XDV or PDF).

    Return type:
    :   `Path`
